notes.title: Nominate First Person Hooper for a Steam Award
notes.notes:
Ever since releasing First Person Hooper this year, many of you have said you enjoyed the chill, pick up & play nature of the game. If you feel this way, consider nominating it for the "Sit Back and Relax" award! 

Thank you for your support of First Person Hooper. All the kind comments, feedback, and compliments have been heartwarming 💙. We appreciate each and every one of our players and look forward to supporting the game in the near future.

notes.title: New Content Update for v1.1.2
notes.notes:
To celebrate Steam Sports Fest, we've released a free cosmetic content update for all players, old and new. Included are 15 new customizations for you to decorate your game with. 

For a limited time (May 15 - 22, 2023), First Person Hooper is available at a discount so please spread the word to friends & family!

Additionally, we're happy to announce the release of First Person Hooper on mobile! It is now available on the App Store for iPhone and iPad devices. Play on the go if you don't already do so on the Steam Deck. 😊

notes.title: First Person Hooper v1.0 is now available!
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=idf6NraHQ2U;full][/previewyoutube]

A message from the developer of First Person Hooper:

It brings me great joy to finally release First Person Hooper to the world. As someone who loves basketball and grew up going to arcades, I always enjoyed the quick pick up & play nature of those games along with their solid gameplay loop. FPH is my first attempt at an arcade-style video game, but with a modern twist in the first-person perspective. It was also inspired by rhythm games, which led to the shot power & timing mechanic that dynamically adjusts to your position from the basket. 

The game is simple at its core, but it also evolves with you. The more you understand the mechanics, the better your high scores and times. My goal is to expand it with more game modes, environments, customizations, features, and new ways to score. This is only the beginning of the journey and I'm honored you have chosen to support the game. Your word of mouth and reviews will only help push this game to new heights so I wholeheartedly appreciate any and all feedback.

With that, get buckets and chill.

Sincerely,
Ejo
